puzzle.title: The Pawn Wedge
puzzle.story: A quiet Italian — until White's center pawn marches forward and attacks the knight and bishop at the same time!
puzzle.pgn: 1. e4 e5 2. Nf3 Nc6 3. Bc4 Be7 4. d3 Nf6 5. O-O O-O 6. Re1 d6 7. c3 Be6 8. Bb3 h6 9. d4 exd4 10. cxd4 Re8 *

lesson.feedback_correct: Yes! The pawn wedges forward and forks the knight on c6 and the bishop on e6.
lesson.feedback_hint: Hint: look at your d-pawn. One push attacks two pieces at once.
lesson.feedback_reveal: The answer was d4-d5, a pawn fork on the knight and bishop.
